name: OpenDataArena
description: OpenDataArena (ODA) is an open platform designed to benchmark the intrinsic value of post-training datasets for large language models. It features a unified training-evaluation pipeline, multi-dimensional data quality scoring, data lineage visualization, and an open-source toolkit to enable principled data-centric AI research.
reputation: A very recent open platform for data-centric LLM research, so community adoption is still limited and early.
notes: Covers over 120 training datasets and 22 benchmarks; enables analysis of data complexity, redundancy, and genealogical relationships.
